about: One real ledger row per kind the gauntlet criteria read, captured from the gauntlet's scripted worlds on this branch's kernel (wave 16 merged) (heaviest-keyed row of each kind), and TH-3's whole boundary and cadence sequence. The unit fixtures in tests/gauntlet/test_criteria.py are checked against these field names. lambda_post.settled and uptake rows come from the edition-6 launch path on the scripted population (scripts/fastloop.py). launch is the gauntlet world's own Launch event row (the diary's binding to its world and seed). On the wave 16 merge the rows were recaptured from the sf1, th1-th4, ld1, of2 and i10 populations; a kind none reaches keeps its earlier captured row (the event row is a ProducerReturn, which the loader's nested fields read). legacy_rows holds, per kind whose shape wave 16 changed, the row captured before it (the pre-wave-16 capture, 95b9fd8^1): what a diary launched before wave 16 holds. Wave 16b captured router.learned, price.contribution, cadence.floor and immune.price_ratchet_saturated from the sf1 and i10 populations on the wave 16b kernel (heaviest-keyed row of each kind).
